scenarios.description: Sign-in page with the one-time code form open and empty.
scenarios.target: The sign-in gate switches to "sign in with a one-time code"; nothing is typed into it.

scenarios.description: Providers page: the provider rail and the selected provider's model list.
scenarios.target: The relay provider is selected in the pinned rail; its two configured models are listed beside it.

scenarios.description: Model health check that passed and shows the model's reply.
scenarios.target: The Demo Model row was tested from the page and shows OK plus the reply text.

scenarios.description: Models page: the three role cards and the save bar.
scenarios.target: Agent, Vision and Tool Model cards, with the Agent thinking effort drafted and unsaved.

scenarios.description: Prompts page: the saved global persona and its applied version.
scenarios.target: The editor holds the seeded persona and shows the applied external version v1.

scenarios.description: Playground room where a persona answered a test scene.
scenarios.target: A held test scene was released and the scripted persona reply is in the timeline.

scenarios.description: Telegram page with no token configured.
scenarios.target: The token was cleared through the dialog: the page says no token is configured.

scenarios.description: Telegram page after saving the token, showing the connected bot.
scenarios.target: The token was saved through this form and the connection reports connected with @surowan_bot.

scenarios.description: Chats page with one allowed Chat.
scenarios.target: The allowlist lists the seeded Chat with its title, topics, model and active state.

scenarios.description: Playground with Hold on and two pending messages.
scenarios.target: The room holds its input; the seeded message plus one typed here are pending, no run exists.

scenarios.description: Playground after a release: the reply and the completed run.
scenarios.target: Releasing the hold ran the bot: the reply is in the timeline and the run card is completed with an Audit link.

scenarios.description: Overview page with the expanded sidebar navigation.
scenarios.target: The dashboard renders real counters, the bot status and the full navigation rail.

scenarios.description: Keychain: entries and the config paths that reference them.
scenarios.target: Used entries name their config paths; one unused entry shows the orphan state.

scenarios.description: API keys page with keys in different permission modes.
scenarios.target: Three keys created through the dialog, one per permission mode, listed with their modes.

scenarios.description: Passkey management list with two registered keys.
scenarios.target: Two passkeys registered through the real WebAuthn ceremony, with the password state.
